title: Non-anchor position period prediction
rationale: This lane predeclares an absolute-position period rule before any new evidence is scored. It is not another public-anchor mining pass because discovery does not use known-plaintext anchors, additive fragment values, candidate words, routed key-material results, held-out anchor controls, source-expanded candidate screens, or prior public-fragment structure screens.
prediction_target: Future independently sourced non-anchor K4 position observations should fall into one or more registered period residue classes at a rate exceeding seeded null, best-of-period, and multiple-comparison controls before any candidate-word, route, or fragment scoring is performed.
discovery_inputs: Predeclared absolute-position period registry emitted before scoring any new observations
Registered period residue classes over non-anchor positions
evaluation_inputs: Future independently sourced non-anchor K4 position observations
Source-documented position observations selected before running period, key-material, route, or fragment scoring
Observation files that identify source rationale before evaluation
controls: seeded shuffle baseline over non-anchor position sets
best-of-period null control across the registered period set
multiple-comparison correction across evaluated period plans
public-anchor positions must be rejected during observation validation
promotion remains blocked unless independent source-backed evidence is positive after all predeclared controls
